pipelineStatisticsQuery.action: Keep false. No PanVK VK_QUERY_TYPE_PIPELINE_STATISTICS path. Occlusion, timestamp, and primitives-generated queries are not pipeline statistics. Software accounting would need per-draw IA/VS/clip/FS/CS counters plus GS/TCS/TES zeros or real stages. Do not expose until every advertised counter matches Vulkan semantics and CTS runs.
notes: IA_PRIMITIVES has a software CSF path only as VK_QUERY_TYPE_PRIMITIVES_GENERATED_EXT, and that extension is not advertised on G615.
Mali pan_perf counters exist for profiling, not wired into PanVK query pools, and do not map 1:1 onto Vulkan pipeline statistic bits.
Pinned and origin/main PanVK both report pipelineStatisticsQuery=false. No backport series exists.
Asahi hk_query_pool.c has a software pipeline-stat path. Cargo-culting it into PanVK is a new implementation, not an upstream PanVK backport.

textureCompressionBC.action: Keep false until transparent BC contract PASSes.

shaderClipDistance.action: Keep false. Primitive-stage clip, then pixel matrix and CTS.

shaderCullDistance.action: Keep false. Primitive-stage cull, then pixel matrix and CTS.

fillModeNonSolid.action: Keep false. Post-vertex primitive expansion, then CTS.

geometryShader.action: Keep false. Complete Valhall v11 GS or PanVK poly/compute lowering, then CTS.

multiViewport.action: Keep false. Hardware proof of v11 ViewportIndex plus per-viewport transform/scissor, then CTS.

VK_EXT_transform_feedback.action: Keep absent. Complete no-IDVS XFB variant, then CTS.

transformFeedback.action: Keep false. Complete no-IDVS XFB variant, then CTS.

geometryStreams.action: Keep false. Complete XFB plus geometryShader, then CTS.

transformFeedbackQueries.action: Keep false. Complete XFB queries after transformFeedback, then CTS.

tessellationShader.action: Keep false. Complete Valhall v11 TCS/TES or PanVK poly/compute lowering, then CTS.

robustImageAccess2.action: Keep false. Complete robustImageAccess2 semantics, then CTS. Blocks stock vkd3d device create.

bufferImageGranularity.action: No driver change. Vulkan finer granularity already satisfies a 65536 profile minimum. Evaluator uses >= and reports FAIL because 64 < 65536. Actual 64 is stricter.

subgroupSupportedOperations[0].action: No driver change. Capture stores a bitmask integer; evaluator compares flattened array string against the integer. 1791 already includes BASIC.

laterPhasesNotStarted.P22: sparseBinding / sparseResidency* / shaderResourceResidency / shaderResourceMinLod / VK_QUEUE_SPARSE_BINDING_BIT / Kbase VM

dxvkRemainingExtras.note: DXVK D3D9/D3D10/D3D11 remaining fails are the same P9-P17 graphics bits. DXVK profiles do not require pipelineStatisticsQuery. P20 does not change DXVK gates.
